answer: A census bond blocks bulk fakes: each identity locks 70 credits and files one return per epoch, key-signed and sealed with an ember stamp. At the epoch zenith, falcon auditors replay one sampled return in eight on the census ledger. Shared returns burn the bond; a reused ember stamp burns both, so rented-census rings fail. Filings cost 35+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,032,000, lock 70,000, for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 35 once, keep the bond.
